top_signals.title: Yen's Fundamentals 'Different This Time Around,' Natixis Says
top_signals.summary: There is room for a "lot of movement" for the yen, according to Trinh Nguyen, senior economist for emerging Asia at Natixis. "The reshoring of not just Japanese investors, the hiking of interest rates, and also on top of that, the fact that JGB yields are very, very attractive and the yen is undervalued,"  Nguyen explains. "All these factors I think means that this time it really is different." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Reliance Plans $1.3 Billion Bond in First Sale Since 2023
top_signals.summary: Billionaire Mukesh Ambani’s Reliance Industries Ltd. is planning to raise as much as 125 billion rupees ($1.3 billion) via local-currency bonds as early as next week, according to people familiar with the matter, which would make it the largest listed deal in the market this year.

top_signals.title: High-Speed Trader AlphaGrep Turns to Bonds After India Bank Curb
top_signals.summary: AlphaGrep Securities Pvt., one of India’s largest high-frequency trading firms, is turning to the bond market for funding after the nation’s central bank tightened banks’ exposure to trading firms that use their own capital.
